##### Project general facts

Opal Gardens Villas by Meydan Group is a luxury residential development located in District 11, Mohammed Bin Rashid City (MBR City), Dubai. The project offers spacious four- to six-bedroom villas designed with large windows that allow natural light to fill the interiors. Generous balconies and terraces extend the living spaces outdoors, with an optional private pool.

The gated community features a range of amenities for residents of different ages, including children's play areas, BBQ zones, a Zen garden, and dedicated yoga spaces. Retail outlets, supermarkets, and schools provide convenient access to everyday essentials and educational facilities, while 24-hour gated security supports a private residential environment.

The villas feature high-end finishes that create an elegant, refined interior. Spacious kitchens are equipped with modern appliances, while the residences are offered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalise their interiors according to their preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

District 11 is part of Mohammed Bin Rashid City (MBR City), a residential destination in Dubai that combines contemporary living with landscaped surroundings. Opal Gardens Villas benefits from its location within this master-planned area, offering residents a private, gated environment while maintaining access to the wider city.

The development is centred around a crystal lagoon and verdant green spaces, creating a natural setting for outdoor activities. More than 5 kilometres of cycling and pedestrian trails provide opportunities for walking, cycling, and enjoying the outdoors.

Opal Gardens Villas also offers convenient access to Downtown Dubai, connecting residents to one of the city's key destinations for shopping, dining, entertainment, and leisure. The combination of green surroundings, outdoor recreation, and urban accessibility makes the development suitable for those seeking a spacious residential lifestyle in Dubai.
